area: Effects: Mod-FX (Chorus/Flanger/Phaser), EQ, SRR/Bitcrush, RMS compressor, analog delay IR
topFunctions: main (inline ImpulseResponseProcessor::process): 42,774 = 334/sample, tap loop not unrolled, 50 smmulr + loads/stores
ModControllableAudio::processFX: Phaser 19,900 (155/sample, allpass state stored to memory at every stage), Chorus 8,881
RMSFeedbackCompressor::render: 11,353 (2x getTanHAntialiased 2D table, state and volume stored per sample)

proposals.title: IR with NEON: vqrdmulhq_s32 with halved coefficients (all 26 are even, so equal to smmulr), L/R and tap pairs in one vector, block method
proposals.risk: low; integer addition stays associative, hash comparison in place

proposals.title: Phaser: allpass state and phaserMemory in local registers, L and R separate, 6 stages unrolled
Compressor: pull calcRMS into the render loop, keep currentVolume/tanh working values/HPF state local, wet check out of the loop; blend without memcpy (read dry before overwriting)
proposals.risk: low; keep the order hpfL(l) then hpfL(r)

proposals.title: EQ: 4 filter states local, specialize the loop by doBass/doTreble
Specialize the mod FX loop per type (template), LFO type, write index and LFO phase local
SRR: lastSample/grabbedSample/positions local; bitcrush with NEON vand

notes: Benchmarks real firmware code. run.sh cuts processFX (mod FX and EQ; the delay call is a no-op), processSRRAndBitcrushing and doEQ unchanged out of mod_controllable_audio.cpp, because the file pulls in the whole firmware. rms_feedback.cpp and impulse_response_processor.h are included in full. Runs on the PC with UBSan and prints hashes for bit-exactness there, and with ARM=1 in the emulator. Grain is not measured. The biggest item is the analog delay IR with 3.7% per instance. Observed, not bit-exact: calcRMS uses hpfL for both channels, hpfR stays unused (bug).
